abstract.t: This document updates RFC 7518 (JSON Web Algorithms (JWA)) to deprecate the JSON Web Signature (JWS) algorithm "none" and the JSON Web Encryption (JWE) algorithm "RSA1_5". These algorithms have known security weaknesses. It updates RFC 7519 (JSON Web Token (JWT)) so that these two algorithms are no longer mandatory to implement. It also updates the review instructions for Designated Experts to establish baseline security requirements that future algorithm registrations are expected to meet.
